propositions: A new rotation sidecar file (.bridge_state/get_rotation.json) must be introduced and dual-written alongside the legacy inline field during the rollout window so interleaved old and new binaries maintain consistent rotation order.
After rotation state initialization, an idempotent real-repo pass with no absent-key GETs must leave all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and not advance HEAD.
A pass with absent-key GETs must advance the same Jira-key stamps in both get_rotation.json and legacy inline fields, and both files must be staged and committed without git add -A.
Legacy-only stores containing only inline stamps must preserve rotation order and materialize equivalent sidecar state on next persisted save, while reconcile-check must not create get_rotation.json.
The outbound_differ.py module must remain at or below 800 lines after extracting rotation accessors and wiring BindingStore to shared rotation logic.
Sidecar load/save must use fail-open semantics, read max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) per Jira key, and persist through all BindingStore.save() paths but not through reconcile-check.
